app_archetype: The Performance Pro / High-Density Crypto Terminal (Swiss precision meets Bloomberg/TradingView terminal style)

language_and_locale.financial_terms: Standard international crypto/trading abbreviations preserved (RSI, MACD, SMA, Support/Resistance, Volume Delta, Bullish, Bearish, Volatility, ATR)

colors.palette_strategy: Deep Obsidian terminal base with Emerald Green (+), Crimson Red (-), Electric Cyan (Technical indicator triggers), and Warm Amber (Fundamental news/sentiment triggers). High APCA contrast compliant.

entry_surfaces./login: split branded terminal auth — high-impact live metrics & hybrid methodology panel left, secure admin credential form with animated status ping right
entry_surfaces./: high-density analytics terminal dashboard — global Indodax status banner + 06:00 WITA countdown header, tabbed Daily/Weekly Top 10 Bullish snapshot table, hybrid score breakdown preview and quick-access watchlist

grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: High-density multi-pane terminal layout (MODE B): top stats ticker strip, main 12-column grid with snapshot table (8 cols) and live market heartbeat/countdown (4 cols)
grids_and_layouts.coin_detail_layout: Asymmetric multi-pane: 8-col TradingView candlestick interactive chart + technical indicator matrix (RSI, MACD, SMA 20/50/200, Support/Resistance), 4-col fundamental news sentiment stream + RSS score breakdown + hybrid weight simulator
grids_and_layouts.evaluation_layout: Performance tracking suite: timeline selector (Harian/Mingguan/Bulanan), Recharts historical projection vs Actual High accuracy curve, chronological deviation ledger table with CSV/PDF export
grids_and_layouts.admin_layout: Two-tab operations cockpit: User Account Provisioning (create user with generated initial password, copy-to-clipboard, revoke/delete) and Hybrid Analysis Weight Configuration (interactive sliders for 70/30 daily, 50/50 weekly, or custom override with auto-save)

principles: Micro-interactions only on terminal tables and metrics (glow border on hover, quick 150ms state shifts)
Countdown timer pulse at T-10 minutes to 06:00 WITA snapshot generation
Tab transitions with lightweight fade-in (opacity 0.2s ease)

accessibility_rules.wcag_level: WCAG AA (minimum 4.5:1 for all text & metrics against dark backgrounds)
accessibility_rules.data_testids: All interactive buttons, inputs, tabs, export actions, and table rows must contain role-based kebab-case `data-testid` attributes (e.g. `data-testid="login-submit-button"`, `data-testid="coin-row-btc-idr"`, `data-testid="export-csv-button"`, `data-testid="sync-api-button"`)

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Application Name & Branding: 'Indo Crypto Lens' (Lensa Kripto Indonesia). Subtitle: 'Platform Analisis Hybrid Kripto Indodax IDR'.

2. Language and Tone: Indonesian-first copy with standard financial/crypto acronyms (RSI, MACD, SMA, Support/Resistance, IDR, Actual High, Proyeksi). Use clean, authoritative fintech phrasing (e.g. 'Snapshot Terkunci', 'Estimasi Kenaikan', 'Skor Sentimen', 'Akurasi Model', 'Hitung Mundur Sinkronisasi').

3. Timezone Logic: All dates and snapshot regenerations must be anchored to WITA (UTC+8 / Waktu Indonesia Tengah). Daily snapshot is regenerated at exactly 06:00 WITA and remains locked valid until 05:59 WITA. Weekly snapshot is regenerated every Monday at 06:00 WITA. Display a live real-time countdown timer to the next 06:00 WITA snapshot generation.

4. Indodax Real-time Market Data Integration: Connect with Indodax Public API endpoints (`https://indodax.com/api/tickers`, `https://indodax.com/api/summaries` or backend mock/cached fetch with fail-safe fallback) for all IDR pairs (BTC/IDR, ETH/IDR, SOL/IDR, DOGE/IDR, XRP/IDR, ADA/IDR, BNB/IDR, etc.). Display live price in IDR (Rp), 24h high/low, and 24h volume.

5. Hybrid Analysis Engine: Combine Technical Analysis (RSI 14, MACD crossover, SMA 20/50/200 trend, Support-Resistance distance) and Fundamental Analysis (RSS news from CoinDesk, Cointelegraph, Decrypt with NLP sentiment polarity scoring -1.0 to +1.0). Default weights: Daily = 70% TA + 30% FA; Weekly = 50% TA + 50% FA. Provide an Admin setting to dynamically re-weight TA/FA.

6. Snapshot Tables (Top 10 Koin Bullish): Sort descending by 'Estimasi Kenaikan %'. Show Rank (#1-10), Pair (e.g. BTC/IDR), Harga Terkini (Rp), Skor Hybrid (0-100), Skor TA (70%), Skor FA (30%), Estimasi Kenaikan (+X.X%), Level Target (Rp), dan Status Validitas Snapshot.

7. Coin Detail Modal / Page: Embed TradingView Interactive Chart widget (for the coin's symbol, e.g. BINANCE:BTCUSDT or INDODAX:BTCIDR with fallback). Provide a Technical Indicator Matrix with gauges/bars (RSI, MACD status, Moving Average consensus), and a Fundamental News Stream showing real RSS headlines, source tags, publication time, and sentiment badges (+Bullish, ~Netral, -Bearish).

8. Evaluation & Accuracy Tracker (Evaluasi Kinerja): Historical performance tracking comparing 'Proyeksi Estimasi' vs 'Actual High tercapai dalam 24 jam/7 hari'. Provide Accuracy Rate % (e.g., 84.2% Sukses Target), Rata-rata Deviasi %, dan Recharts Line/Bar Chart untuk tren akurasi harian, mingguan, dan bulanan.

9. Admin Features: (a) User Management: Admin can generate accounts for team members with an auto-generated secure password (with Copy to Clipboard feature) and Delete/Revoke user. (b) Analysis Weights Config: Slider controls to adjust Daily & Weekly TA/FA percentage split.
10. Export Features: Provide CSV Export for Top 10 Bullish Snapshots and Evaluation logs, plus a clean Print-to-PDF layout (`window.print()` with `@media print` clean formatting).

11. Authentication & Security: Session-based auth with httpOnly cookies via FastAPI (`/api/auth/login`, `/api/auth/me`, `/api/auth/logout`) with admin role checking. Protected dashboard routes that smoothly redirect unauthenticated users to `/login`.
12. Theme Support: Full Dark Mode default with seamless Light Mode toggle using Tailwind CSS and `next-themes` or class switching. High contrast terminal feel with vibrant indicators.
